adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the code does `user_id = params.require(:user_id).to_i` and then calls `group.users.delete(user_id)`. `group.users` is an ActiveRecord association collection, and `delete` on a collection is intended to be passed record objects (e.g., a `User`), not a raw Integer id. Passing an Integer will not reliably remove the membership and in common Rails versions will raise `ActiveRecord::AssociationTypeMismatch` (since it checks the class of each "record" argument), so the membership removal can fail.
